content.title: TINY HABITS, {{HUGE}} PAYOFFS
facts: **Splash cold water on your face** every morning — it stimulates the vagus nerve, slowing your heart rate and sharpening focus within seconds.
**Walk for 10 minutes after eating** — this simple move blunts blood sugar spikes and speeds up digestion far more than sitting does.
**Stand on one leg while brushing your teeth** — it quietly trains balance and core stability, lowering fall risk as you age.
**Take 5 slow belly breaths before meals** — it shifts your body into rest-and-digest mode, easing bloating and improving nutrient absorption.
**Get natural light within 30 minutes of waking** — this resets your internal clock, leading to deeper sleep and steadier energy all day.
**Chew each bite closer to 20 times** — it gives your brain time to register fullness, naturally reducing overeating.
**Stretch your calves before bed** — better blood flow here can cut down on nighttime leg cramps and restless sleep.
